name: open
description: Open a single-web window: one tab showing `url`, a read-only address, back / forward / reload and the OS caption buttons. The window is pinned to the kSingleWeb UI mode, is never restored by session restore, and belongs to the connection that opened it: its events (onNavigated, onTitleChanged, onClosed) go to that connection only, and it is closed when that connection goes away. Only http, https and file URLs are accepted. With `captureRedirect` (a loopback http URL with an explicit port: localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1], no credentials; invalid_args otherwise) a main-frame navigation in the window that starts at, or is redirected to, that URL (scheme, host, port and path equal; query and fragment ignored) is cancelled before any request reaches the port, onRedirectCaptured { windowId, url } (the full URL, query included) goes to the owning connection, and the window is then closed (onClosed reason 'api'). At most one capture per window; `url` itself may not match captureRedirect. Manifest primitive webWindow.captureRedirect. With `title` (1–120 characters after whitespace runs collapse; invalid_args otherwise) the window's title row and its OS window title show that text for the window's whole life, whatever the page sets as document.title; onTitleChanged and list still report the page's own title. Manifest primitive webWindow.title. Returns { windowId }.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: The page to show: an http, https or file URL.

inputs.name: left
inputs.description: Screen x of the window's top-left corner, in DIPs.

inputs.name: top
inputs.description: Screen y of the window's top-left corner, in DIPs.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Window width in DIPs, at least 200.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Window height in DIPs, at least 150.

inputs.name: focus
inputs.description: Activate the window once shown. Absent: true.

inputs.name: captureRedirect
inputs.description: A loopback http URL (localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1], explicit port, no credentials) whose navigation is captured and reported as onRedirectCaptured instead of sent.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: A fixed window title, shown in the title row and as the OS window title instead of the page's title; the page cannot change it.
